sources.citation: Barrick Lab. LTEE-Ecoli: Genomics resources for the Long-Term Evolution Experiment with E. coli.
sources.notes: Public genomics resource for LTEE mutation data. No raw files are imported by this scaffold.

sources.citation: Sprouffske K, Aguilar-Rodriguez J, Sniegowski P, Wagner A. 2018. High mutation rates limit evolutionary adaptation in Escherichia coli. PLOS Genetics 14(4): e1007324.
sources.license_or_terms: Creative Commons Attribution License listed by PLOS article.
sources.download_method: PLOS supplementary S3 Table downloaded manually from article file endpoint; Dryad phenotyping archive not imported.
sources.notes: Relevant for engineered E. coli mutation-rate treatments, selected-environment growth, robustness assays, and sequencing results. calibration_dataset_v0 currently includes only S3 genomic mutation-rate values and confidence intervals, not fitness values.

sources.citation: Couce A, Viraphong Caudwell L, Feinauer C, Hindre T, Feugeas JP, Weigt M, Lenski RE, Schneider D, Tenaillon O. 2017. Mutator genomes decay, despite sustained fitness gains, in a long-term experiment with bacteria. PNAS 114:E9026-E9035.
sources.license_or_terms: See publisher page for article and supplementary-material terms.
sources.notes: Relevant for separating selected-environment fitness gains from genome-decay signatures in LTEE mutator populations.

sources.citation: Maddamsetti R, Grant NA. 2020. Divergent Evolution of Mutation Rates and Biases in the Long-Term Evolution Experiment with Escherichia coli. Genome Biology and Evolution 12(9):1591-1603.
sources.license_or_terms: Open Access article; see Oxford Academic page for license terms.
sources.notes: Relevant for LTEE mutation-rate and mutation-bias evolution across replicate populations.
